Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>visible</p><div style="font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)"><span style="line-height:0">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
